name: Privacy in Large Language Models (LLM-PBE)
description: A competition to identify and mitigate privacy vulnerabilities in large language models, focusing on sensitive information leakage and defense mechanisms.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: Participants interact with LLMs using text-based inputs. For the Red Team Track, inputs are queries designed to probe for sensitive information. For the Blue Team Track, inputs include LLMs under simulated privacy attacks, along with attack scenarios and prompts.
cr:input.url: [FILL IN THE BLANK: URL to the competition dataset]

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: Red Team Track outputs include extracted sensitive information (e.g., 'Xylo Zeta', 'xylo.zeta@randommail.com'). Blue Team Track outputs include sanitized LLM responses that prevent leakage of sensitive information while maintaining utility.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for the sample, e.g., sample_001

field.name: pred
field.description: output prediction, such as extracted sensitive information or sanitized output

cr:evaluation.notes: Metrics vary by track. For the Red Team, 'Attack Accuracy' measures success in extracting sensitive information (higher is better), while 'Efficiency' measures the number of tokens or queries required (lower is better). For the Blue Team, 'Defense Effectiveness' and 'Model Effectiveness' measure the success of defenses and LLM performance post-defense (higher is better). 'Efficiency' for the Blue Team evaluates computational overhead (lower is better). Statistical tests like t-tests and ANOVA ensure result consistency.
